notes.title: Patch 0.4.4.2

- New Skin Added
- Quality of life improvement
- Small bug fix

notes.title: 💥 BIG FEBRUARY UPDATE 💥
notes.notes:
-> 2 NEW ENEMY TYPES: 

	- Plasma shooter WASP soldier

	- Energy wheel blast WASP soldier

-> 10 NEW MUTATION TRIGGER UPGRADES: 

	- ALL ROUND -> Unleashes a 360° ranged attack, automatically

	- FEELING SPECIAL ->  Lowers the number of kills needed to charge your special attack 

	- BEATDOWN BOUNTY -> Increases your melee attack damage per enemies killed

	- BULLET BOUNTY -> Increases your ranged attack damage per enemies killed

	- BLOW-BLOCK BOUNTY -> Decreases damage taken per enemies killed

	- MIRROR ATTACK -> Deals damage automatically right after you get hit

	- THE HACKER -> Hacks a drone companion to fire automated ranged attacks at enemies

	- FLASH HACKER -> Makes your drone companion fire faster

	- POWER HACKER -> Makes your drone deal more damage with each shot

	- IT’S ELECTRIFYING! -> Makes your melee attack create a lightning strike chain reaction 

-> MINOR BALANCE & PROGRESSION ADJUSTMENTS

-> NEW LIMITED-TIME COLLECTABLE “THE HEARTBREAK KID” SUNGLASSES

-> MINOR AESTHETIC ADJUSTMENTS
